nonfinite_capture_script:
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
import json,math
from pathlib import Path
from pm4py.algo.discovery.heuristics.variants import classic
rows=[]
for label,value in [('nan',float('nan')),('positive_infinity',float('inf')),('negative_infinity',float('-inf')),('nested',{'x':[float('inf')]})]:
 n=classic.apply_heu_dfg({('A','B'):1},performance_dfg={('A','B'):value})
 edge=next(iter(next(iter(n.nodes['A'].output_connections.values()))))
 actual=edge.repr_value
 matched=(math.isnan(actual)if label=='nan'else actual==value)
 rows.append({'input_class':label,'accepted':True,'preserved':matched})
 assert matched
Path('build/heuristic-dfg-nonfinite-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
print(rows)
nonfinite_transport_behavior: Discovery retains nonfinite supplied values; JSON export rejects them with invalid_argument because they are not JSON numbers.
